messages.subject: Renewal - non-negotiable points before we sign
messages.body:
Tomás,

Ahead of tomorrow's call, so nobody wastes time: the renewal terms you sent are close, but I have one condition that is not a bargaining chip. Our drivers lose signal in the port terminals and the Antwerp tunnels on a daily basis. Your current app simply stops working and dispatch has no idea what the driver last saw. I need the v3 app to work offline - cached routes, cached manifests, at minimum - on day one of the pilot, or there is no renewal and I will say so to Marta directly.

You told me in February the app already handled this. It does not. Sort it out.

Bruno Alvarez
COO, Redline Couriers

messages.subject: FW: Renewal - non-negotiable points before we sign - NEED INPUT TONIGHT
messages.body:
Team, see below. Bruno is in one of his moods but this one is real ✅ We cut offline mode from v3 two weeks ago and he has just made it the renewal condition 🚀

The call with Redline is tomorrow (Wednesday) 15:00. I need to know tonight whether some form of offline is technically possible before the 100% rollout, and what it costs us. Priya, Dev - what are our options? Please cc me on everything, I do not want to walk into that call blind.

Saludos,
Tomás
